execution.onUncertainSubmission: Stop. Inspect the official work list and save evidence. Never re-upload or click publish again while the outcome is uncertain.
execution.onExistingExactTitle: Do not publish again. Collect official-list evidence and report the existing work for reconciliation.
instructions: Read GitHub daily/current.json and select only today's entry in Asia/Shanghai. Use only the authorized ready task bound by that entry.
The production/export stage owns video QA, inventory, historical publication reconciliation and scheduling. A ready task is its completed validation result.

Dot must not restore history, access local ledgers, atomically claim a task, prove old workflows are excluded, or repeat production QA before upload. Missing historical records or an old-workflow exclusion proof is not a blocker.
Download the task media and verify its SHA-256 for transfer consistency. Use each platform's supplied copy and settings, select matching official topics, and use video frame 0 as the cover.
Publish each platform once and report its actual result with the official recent-work screenshot/link. Evidence collection happens after submission and is not an upload prerequisite.
Within this execution, do not repeat a platform that succeeded. If a submission outcome becomes uncertain, inspect that platform's official list before any retry; do not re-upload while uncertain.

copy.title: 人需要看见自己的努力有回声
copy.description: 忙了一整天，最累的也许不是事情太多，而是说不清究竟做成了什么。《这游戏也太真实了》把共同重建写得热闹，也提醒我们：拧紧一个龙头、换亮一盏灯，具体的小变化会让努力重新有回声。

execution.onUncertainSubmission: Stop this platform. Inspect official work/note management before retry. Never re-upload while uncertain.
execution.onUnsupportedSetting: If a requested setting has no available control or cannot be configured, keep the platform default and continue publishing without requesting additional confirmation. For that unavailable setting, this fallback takes precedence over its requested value and setting-specific requirements. Report the setting as left at platform default; never claim its requested value was verified.
